name: pipe_file_operations

ownership.argument: NuttX pipe file-operations table that a pipe inode stores at inode+16. Astrolink compares the inode's operations pointer against this table to prove that the two files it pinned in the default loop's owning filelist are that loop's pipe, before it writes a wake byte to them. Read-only identity; it is never called.

provenance.source: the .155 native probe accepts the default loop pair (18/18 lifecycle checks) only when inode->i_ops equals this table; its ten words name the pipe handlers 0xc32e0e9/0xc32e019/0xc32cddd/0xc32ce9d/0xc328955 and friends, which is the same set .139 and .179 place at their own addresses.

notes: Address catalogue only; the table is compared, never called. Device-proven identity, static address.
